items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh, speaking of drummers, I'm still thinking about this fella called Cookshop Son. Did you ever know his real name? [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: He was a little fella from uptown. He was playing, uh, playing, uh, drum. And after that, well, I come down this way.
